senses.gloss: मज् मज्. See निर्-मज्, p. 498, col. 3.

मज्ज् मज्ज् (in the Dhātu-pāṭha written
मस्ज्), cl. 6. P. (ep. also A.) मज्जति,
(-ते), ममज्ज (2nd sing. ममज्जिथ or म-
मङ्क्थ), मङ्क्ष्यति (ep. also मज्जिष्यति),
अमाङ्क्षीत् (ep. 2nd sing. अमज्जीस्; with particle
मा, मज्जीस्), मङ्क्तुम् or मज्जितुम्, to sink (in
water), dive, bathe, be submerged or immersed; to
dip one's self, plunge, bathe, throw one's self into
water; to sink down, sink under, sink into (with
loc. or acc., e. g. तमो मज्जति, he sinks into dark-
ness, Manu IV. 81); to be drowned, perish in
water, perish; to sink into misfortune, become
ruined; to despond, be disheartened: Caus. मज्ज-
यति, -यितुम्, Aor. अममज्जत्, to cause to sink (in
water), immerse, submerge, dip, bathe, cause to
plunge or dive, drown, deluge, cause to perish, over-
whelm: Desid. मिमङ्क्षति, मिमज्जिषति: In-
tens. मामज्ज्यते, मामङ्क्ति; [cf. Lat. mergo:
Lith. merkiu, ‘macero;’ mazgoju = Caus. मज्ज-
यामि.]

मजमुदार मजमुदार = مجموع دار; मज्-
मूऽ-दार्, a record-keeper, document-holder.

मजिरक मजिरक, अस्, m., N. of a man
(Gaṇa Śivādi to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 112; cf. माजिरक).

माजिरक माजिरक, अस्, m. (fr. मजिरक),
a patronymic (Gaṇa Śivādi to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 112).
मज्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, sinking, diving; [cf. उद-म्˚.]

मज्जा, f. the marrow of the bones or flesh [cf.
निर्-मज्ज]; pith, sap, the sap of plants.
—मज्जा-
गत, अस्, आ, अम्, seated in the marrow (as a
disease).
—मज्जा-ज, अस्, m. a species of bdellium
(= भूमिज-गुग्गुलु).
—मज्जा-मेह, अस्, m., N.
of a particular disease of the urinary organs.
—मज्जा-
रजस्, अस्, n. a particular hell; bdellium.
—मज्जा-
रस, अस्, m. ‘marrow-secretion,’ semen virile.
—मज्जा-सार, अम्, n. nutmeg.

मज्जत्, अन्, अन्ती or अती, अत्, sinking, drowning,
dipping, bathing.

मज्जन्, आ, m. (said to be fr. rt. मज्ज् above,
according to some for an original मर्जन्?), the
marrow of the bones and flesh; the pith or sap of
plants; (in the later medical system) the element or
essential ingredient [cf. धातु] of the body which
is produced from the bones and itself produces semen;
[cf. Old Germ. marag; Angl. Sax. mearg, merg.]
—मज्ज-कृत्, त्, n. ‘producing marrow,’ a bone.
—मज्जन्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. marrowy, (op-
posed to अ-मज्जक.)
—मज्ज-समुद्भव, अम्,
n. ‘produced from the marrow,’ semen virile.

मज्जन, अस्, m. ‘the diver,’ N. of a kind of
supernatural being; N. of one of Śiva's attend-
ants; (अम्), n. the act of sinking or sinking under
water, diving, immersion; dipping, bathing, ablution;
perishing in water, drowning; deluging; = मज्जन्
above.
मज्जान, अस्, m. = मज्जल, col. 2.

मज्जयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who causes to
sink or plunge.

मज्जल, अस्, m., N. of one of Skanda's attend-
ants, (also read मज्जान; cf. मज्जन.)

माजल माजल, अस्, m. a kind of bird, the
blue roller.
मज्जस्, अस्, n. = मज्जन्, marrow.
मज्जिका, f. the female of the Indian crane.
माजिक माजिक, अस्, m., N. of a man.

मज्जूक, अस्, आ, अम्, repeatedly or habitually
diving (used in Nirukta IX. 5. to explain the word
मण्डूक).
मज्जूषा मज्जूषा, f. = मञ्जूषा.

मज्मना मज्मना, ind. (inst. case of a form
मज्मन्; cf. मंहना), Ved. in one mass, to-
gether, collectively, in one body, generally; with or
by strength, by might, by intensity (Sāy. = बलेन,
according to Naighaṇṭuka 11. 9. मज्मना = बल);
[cf. Lat. magmentum.]
माजल-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a city.

माजीज माजीज, N. of a place; (also read
माजुज and माजूज.)
